verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents an agent that takes a plain-English request or a team-approved plan, builds the change in an isolated sandbox with a live preview, and delivers a tracked pull request for engineering review, which covers end-to-end feature implementation. The only test-related evidence is a 'Tests status' item in the Merge Readiness score, which shows tests are checked but not that the agent writes them. Missing for 10: documented agent authoring of tests, independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end feature delivery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent implement a requested feature end-to-end, including writing tests

citations.quote: Describe the change in plain English. LightSprint builds it, spins up a live preview, and prepares for engineering review.
For larger features, plan first and align as a team. Pick options and mockups before anything is built, then hand the plan off as one implementation task.
Track each pull request in Review Hub, where engineers can check readiness and merge.
